{"markdown":"# CP-5 — Ares Capital Corporation

## Request

View: Ares Capital Corporation's current five-screen Lite handoff is supportable for historical screening-only consumption, subject to its stated source and analytical limitations. This review found no confirmed defect in the scoped Lite consumption, topic allocation, upgrade coverage or priority ordering. It does not clear an investment decision, current compliance, usable funding capacity or security selection.

Run `sol-remaining-arcc-lite-assurance-20261105`; issuer_id `ARCC`; module `CP-5`; method `deploy-v-r14`; public / credit_snapshot. Reporting anchor: 2024-12-31; comparisons: FY2024/FY2023; subsequent events: January/February 2025; execution: 2026-11-05. This is an ex-post historical integrity/trace review, not a point-in-time availability backtest or a present-market update.

One model performed separate-module consumption of the complete supplied CP-L10 and current CP-3D, CP-3/absorbed CP-3A and CP-4/CP-4A handoffs. This is not independent-agent assurance, a new full seventeen-register CP-5 case, or a fresh issuer pathway. No issuer thesis, canonical financial history, forecast, valuation, recovery, security preference or size is newly authored.

## Sources

Text extraction, not visual inspection, is the basis of this review.

The four exact upstream identities consumed are:

## Findings

### Review conclusion

**Clearance: pass for the specified historical screening-only consumption, with source limitations retained.** No confirmed scoped defect requires repair before existing delivery. All five screens retain PARTIAL source gates, MIXED execution bases, COMPLETE_WITH_GAPS statuses and FULL_UPGRADE_REQUIRED analytical dispositions. Their postures—MIXED, MIXED, WATCH, ESCALATE_FOR_FULL_SELECTION and WATCH—are permitted literals, not underwriting outcomes.

The twenty exact table families are present in the required order. Each allocation has six unique canonical topics and exact source-owner sets; all five decision screens have one OVERALL row. Every DEEPEN and material GAP_ONLY allocation has a topic-matched upgrade row with missing inputs, decision impact, required source, permitted target owner, expected owned object and blocking flag. The two SUMMARIZE topics are source basis and controlling-document identity; no required upgrade was hidden by a quota. There are twenty-five DEEPEN, three GAP_ONLY and two SUMMARIZE allocations, with twenty-eight corresponding mandatory upgrade rows. These are observed coverage counts, not budgets or new analytical scores.

The observed evidence-to-transmission-to-implication-to-owner chains and strongest contrary cases remain conditional. L does not convert rising NII, unchanged average grade or reported coverage into sufficient liquidity; nor does it convert nonaccrual changes, missing certificates or negative CFO into default. D/S uncertainty is consumed rather than re-ranked. No fixed deepening quota, depth cap, reserve pool or security reranking was identified.

### Counterfactual probes

Four dangerous mutations were tested by comparing the actual text with the governing evidence, not by editing the upstream artifact or running a mutation engine. First, promoting860 combined cash, conditional5.1bn facilities or2,219 ceiling difference into usable cash/certified debt capacity would fail A115/255/88 and C's definitions; L expressly prevents that promotion. Second, collapsing150% note incurrence,150% facility maintenance and below100%/24-month default—or importing101% into the July combined-event offer—would change legal meaning; B/J and L retain their distinct conditions. Third, converting evaluated A/B yield cases or the surviving dirty-case pair premium into executable risk-adequate preference would contradict D/S; L preserves uncertainty and does not select. Fourth, converting HIGH/MISSING ESG, trajectory or technicals requests into adverse/favorable analysis, IMMATERIAL classifications or omitted upgrades would violate all five adaptive methods and common policy; all three remain request-only throughout L. None of these hypothetical mutations is an actual finding, and none inflates the issue count.

## Calculations

### Arithmetic review

The three L calculations were independently checked for operand transcription, signed subtraction, period, units and scope against A p6/original116:

- FY2024 investment income2,990 plus negative FY2023 income2,614 = **+376 USDm**.
- FY2024 NII1,403 plus negative FY2023 NII1,266 = **+137 USDm**.
- FY2024 diluted EPS2.44 plus negative FY2023 diluted EPS2.68 = **−0.24 USD/share**.

They are consolidated annual descriptive changes without normalization, pro forma adjustment or a denominator. No new calculated financial history is created. L reports prior Decimal-38 execution; its raw execution log is not independently supplied here. CP-5 verifies the displayed arithmetic but does not claim to have re-executed that producer log. No calculate call was necessary for these exact simple differences.

D/S yield roots, PVs, loss proxies, rounding intervals and C's capacity arithmetic were not independently re-executed. Their consumed values and scope restrictions agree across the four current handoffs; the claim trace distinguishes producer support from primary-source verification. Actual usable dollar debt, RP/leakage capacity and numerical recovery remain **Not calculable** because legal inputs, uses, constraints, claim reach and realizable-value evidence are incomplete.

### Priority consumption controls

I independently ordered each screen's six declared tuples: urgency descending, magnitude descending, evidence confidence descending, then canonical index ascending. All thirty supplied ranks agree; no arithmetic ordering exception was found. Urgency and magnitude are authored attention judgments supported by L's rationale, not facts proved by sorting. Evidence-confidence keys follow the declared evidence-status mapping; they are not probabilities or a numeric assurance score. In particular HIGH on the three missing topics is conservative decision attention, not an incident/loss estimate.

Canonical index resets within each screen. L10 and L40 place canonical topics2–6 ahead of their urgency2/MEDIUM identity topics. L20 places its urgency3 topics2,3,5 first, then urgency2/HIGH topic1, missing topic6 and MEDIUM topic4. L23 places urgency3/PARTIAL topics1,3,6 ahead of missing topic5, then urgency2 topics2,4. L30 places its five PARTIAL topics in canonical order ahead of missing topic3. ## Gaps

### Request-only controls retained

The three HIGH/MISSING allocations remain GAP_ONLY with no topic-level analytical conclusion in prose, decision screens, OVERALL rows or synthesis:

- **L20/ESG_TRANSITION → CP-2F:** actual exposure/incident records, costs, transition plans and executed sustainability-linked instrument terms are Not supplied. Their absence prevents transmission/materiality assessment. L TL20.4 requests issuer/portfolio incident/exposure records, cost schedules and instrument terms; generic A35–36 risks establish neither an actual incident nor immateriality.
- **L23/BASE_DOWNSIDE_TRAJECTORY → CP-2G:** horizon and supported collection/default/mark/funding assumptions and cases are Not supplied. No directional case trajectory can be assessed. L TL23.4 requests supported historical-anchor assumptions and base/downside inputs; A100 static issuer sensitivities do not supply those missing cases.
- **L30/LIQUIDITY_TECHNICALS → CP-3D:** two-way executable lots, depth, trade/no-trade history and holder/flow records are Not supplied. Execution/technical effects cannot be assessed. L TL30.4 requests dated dealer depth, trade and ownership/flow evidence; evaluated size/price evidence is not a substitute.

L's remaining twenty-five DEEPEN upgrades also retain precise missing-input/impact/source/owner requests. Requests to already completed bounded D/S/C functions are limited to affected missing inputs; they do not pretend those producers were absent, nor that their completion supplied full current underwriting. No missing amount is assigned zero, and no absent certificate, event history or disclosure is treated as proof of current compliance, default or adverse behavior.

### Review limitations

This review applies claim-support, definitions/arithmetic, legal-control, market-basis, cross-module/version, schema/coverage and authority-boundary tests to the actual four current handoffs. It does not claim full native seventeen-register assurance, CP-5A execution/clearance, host filesystem inspection, script validation, export rendering/parity, native accepted-head/profile acceptance or broader pathway completion. The full CP-5 trace/QA workflow tested on another case is not ARCC execution evidence and supplies no issuer facts or scores here.

Confidence is high in the observed table/topic/owner/rank consistency and directly read annual/legal extractions, and more limited in producer-dependent mathematics or finer disclosures whose underlying source files are outside this selected pack. Complete raw calculation logs, the March supplement/base, Treasury observations, finer C financial pages, operative facility agreement, certificates, usage trackers and entity/value-access schedules were not independently verified here. These are disclosed limits, not newly discovered defects in a handoff that already qualifies them. The A95/A300 swap-date conflict remains unresolved; operative confirmation is required before any affected CP-2E/legal use.

Historical management compliance statements are attributed as of December2024, not independently certified or carried forward to November2026. January issuance and February authorization remain subsequent. No LQD, TDG, Ford or Frontier facts or scores enter this review. References to cross-issuer mutation hazards do not import those issuers' economics or rights.

## Next module

Use the **existing delivery process** to preserve the exact checked CP-L10, this CP-5 handoff and the current D/S/C raw lineage, without reanalysis, reranking, restatement or overwriting producer qualifications. Retain all thirty topic ranks and all owned evidence requests.
